prompt: Convert 1-butanol to 1-bromobutane with PBr₃. Draw the product.
explanation: PBr₃ converts 1° and 2° alcohols to alkyl bromides with inversion of configuration. Mechanism: OH attacks P, kicking out Br⁻; Br⁻ then does SN2 on the activated carbon. Milder and more selective than HBr for sensitive substrates.
